answer: Give every new identity a narrow terrace of permissions that widens only after it completes verified work for distinct, established peers. A Sybil farm must then climb the same slow spiral of trust for each fake, paying real compute and waiting real time per identity instead of spawning a thousand accounts at once. At the wharf, each arriving identity's history is checked against the ledger, so a fresh account with no past cannot outvote one that has delivered work for months.
